feature.title: Orion/Aider Separation & Adapters
feature.description: Implement Orion as separate LLM agent and create Aider adapter with JSON extraction.

tasks.title: Implement Orion as Direct LLM Agent
tasks.description: Create Orion database tools, integrate DeepSeek API, build Orion wrapper with database tool calling.

subtasks.title: Define semantic tool schemas for database operations
subtasks.description: Create tool schemas for common operations: db_get_subtask_by_id, db_list_subtasks_by_status, db_update_subtask_status, db_append_subtask_log, db_search_subtasks_by_keyword

subtasks.title: Implement safe-SQL tools with DDL restrictions
subtasks.description: Create controlled schema evolution tools: db_add_column_to_table, db_create_table_from_migration. Block DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, DELETE operations.

subtasks.title: Integrate DeepSeek API with tool-calling prompt templates
subtasks.description: Set up DeepSeek API integration, create prompt templates for planning and CDP, implement conversation management with database logging.

subtasks.title: Build Orion wrapper with Plan/Act mode tool locking
subtasks.description: Create Orion wrapper with mode-based tool restrictions (Cline-style), implement context aggregation from database and files.

subtasks.title: Test end-to-end planning workflow with mock Orion
subtasks.description: Test Orion planning with database interaction, verify CDP analysis identifies constraints accurately, ensure planning completes within 2 minutes.

tasks.title: Build Aider Adapter with JSON Extraction
tasks.description: Create wrapper for Aider CLI execution, implement natural language JSON extraction and validation, add retry logic for failed JSON parsing.

subtasks.title: Build Aider CLI wrapper with timeout handling
subtasks.description: Create module to execute Aider commands programmatically, implement context passing, add timeout and error handling for long-running commands.

subtasks.title: Implement JSON extraction layer with validation
subtasks.description: Create natural language JSON parsing utilities, add validation against expected schemas, implement retry logic for failed JSON parsing.

subtasks.title: Integrate with database status change hooks
subtasks.description: Create webhook system for database status changes, map status values to Aider execution modes (Tara/Devon), implement result logging back to database.

subtasks.title: Test Tara → Devon → Tara execution cycle
subtasks.description: Test complete Aider execution cycle, verify JSON extraction success rate >90%, ensure results logged to database automatically.

tasks.title: Status-Driven Workflow Triggers
tasks.description: Create webhook system for status changes, implement agent dispatch based on subtask status, add logging and error handling for failed executions.

subtasks.title: Create webhook system for status changes
subtasks.description: Implement database triggers or polling mechanism to detect status changes, create event dispatcher for agent execution.

subtasks.title: Implement agent dispatch based on subtask status
subtasks.description: Map status values to agent actions: ready_for_tara → Aider (Tara), ready_for_devon → Aider (Devon), ready_for_review → Aider (Tara).

subtasks.title: Add logging and error handling for failed executions
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive error logging, add retry logic for failed agent executions, create UI notifications for failed operations.

tasks.title: UI-Database Integration
tasks.description: Connect frontend to PostgreSQL database, update backend APIs, test end-to-end data flow.

subtasks.title: Analyze current API endpoints and database schema for UI integration
subtasks.description: Review frontend TaskList.vue API calls, examine backend server.js endpoints, check database schema for missing tables, identify gaps between current JSON structure and database schema.

subtasks.title: Create database tables for features and tasks if missing
subtasks.description: Create migration for features table, create migration for tasks table, update subtasks table to include task_id and feature_id foreign keys, run migrations to update database schema.

subtasks.title: Implement database queries for project structure
subtasks.description: Create db.features module with getAll, getById methods, create db.tasks module with getByFeature, getAll methods, create db.subtasks module with getByTask, getAllWithDetails methods, implement joint query to fetch full project structure.

subtasks.title: Update backend API endpoints to use database
subtasks.description: Update /api/project endpoint to fetch from database instead of JSON file, create /api/features endpoint for feature-specific data, create /api/tasks endpoint for task management, ensure /api/subtask/:id endpoint works with database, add error handling and validation.

subtasks.title: Update frontend to use enhanced APIs and test integration
subtasks.description: Verify frontend TaskList.vue works with updated /api/project endpoint, test subtask modal with /api/subtask/:id endpoint, add loading states and error handling in UI, test end-to-end data flow from database to UI.
